subject: Transient reprocessing playbook and residency matrix request
messages:
From: Alex Morris <alex.morris@healthco.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@healthco.com
Date: 2026-08-08T09:14:00Z
Subject: Residency constraints for pilot — brief clarification

Marcus —

Quick question on the pilot kick-off next week (HC analytics ingestion). Legal flagged a short window where our analytics backfill and enrichment jobs may route through a US-based edge aggregator for batch deduping before returning results to EU storage. Can you confirm:

- Whether transient reprocessing of tokenized / KV-cache entries would be considered "cross-border processing" under the DPA addendum we discussed.
- If Redwood can provide a matrix that lists where each processing component will run (control plane, inference, analytics aggregation) and any temporary hops (max duration and triggers).

We need the matrix and runbook to sign off with our DPO and SecOps. If there are guardrails for short-lived hops (e.g., <2 hours for emergency replay) please include them.

Thanks,
Alex Morris
DPO, HealthCo

Attachments: example_ingest_flow.drawio (referenced)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@healthco.com>
Cc: k iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-08T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Residency constraints for pilot — brief clarification

Alex —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front:

- Transient reprocessing that touches infrastructure outside the EU control plane can be considered cross-border processing unless it meets one of our documented transient-hop exceptions (short timeboxed replay for telemetry/ops).
- I attached a first-pass residency matrix and an ops-runbook that describes the transient-hop policy we propose for the pilot. The matrix maps logical components to placement (inference, KV/redis cache, analytics aggregator, control plane) and flags any components that may touch us-east1 during backfill.

Key excerpts from the runbook:
- Emergency replay window: max 90 minutes for an automated dedupe/aggregation job; any replay >90 minutes requires preapproval from Customer DPO and Redwood Ops.
- KV cache snapshotting: only ephemeral cache shards would be serialized and sent to the aggregator; persistent storage remains in eu-west-1.
- Audit telemetry: every transient hop logs a signed event with customer identifier, timestamp, reason, and SRE on-duty. Audit events are retained for 180 days (we can extend per contract).

Next steps: Marcus/Marissa to run an ops-simulation in our staging environment and provide the telemetry sample we log during a transient hop. Karthik — can you run the simulation with the HC payload (anonymized) and attach the sample events?

I'll follow up with a short note for legal to include in the DPA addendum.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_residency_matrix_v1.xlsx, ops-transient-reprocessing-runbook.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-08T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Residency constraints for pilot — brief clarification

Marcus / Marissa —

I executed the staging simulation this morning (OPS-9123). Summary of what I tested and what the sample telemetry shows:

- Scenario: 10k messages backfill that triggers the aggregator to perform dedupe in us-east1 for 12 minute intervals; results written back to eu-west-1 storage.
- Observability: we log hop.start, hop.end, reason, hop.duration_ms, trace_id, and operator_id. Sample event (anonymized) attached as text in the runbook appendix.
- KV behavior: we snapshot only ephemeral cache keys (prefix hc_). No persistent indices were exported.
- Failure modes: if the aggregator cannot complete within 90 minutes the job aborts and kicks off a rollback path; we notify both Redwood SRE and HealthCo SecOps.

Ops ask for legal: please confirm whether the 90-minute automated window is acceptable as a standard exception in the DPA addendum, or whether you need a stricter cap or pre-approval gating.

I can also produce a sample audit bundle (signed events + redwood_trace) for your security review.

-Karthik
Senior SRE
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@healthco.com>, security@healthco.com
Cc: k iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T16:42:00Z
Subject: Residency matrix + proposed transient-hop exception for pilot (HC-4872)

Alex / HealthCo SecOps —

Appreciate the patience while we ran the ops simulation. Attached are two artifacts you requested: a residency matrix (component-by-component placement) and an operations runbook that includes an appendix with the anonymized telemetry sample and the audit event format. Highlights and commitments for the pilot: 

1) Placement commitments
- Control plane (management APIs, orchestration): eu-west-1
- Inference serving for pinned model: eu-west-1 (no inference tokenization in other regions)
- Analytics aggregator for the backfill: occasional transient hop to us-east1 under the conditions below
- Persistent customer storage (logs, object store): eu-west-1

2) Proposed transient-hop guardrails (pilot-specific)
- Window: automated reprocessing/replay jobs may create transient hops up to 90 minutes total per incident.
- Scope: only ephemeral cache snapshots and derived analytics artifacts necessary for dedupe/aggregation; no persistent index exports.
- Notification: SecOps will receive an automated alert on hop.start and hop.end with the trace_id.
- Audit retention: 180 days by default; we are open to extending to 365 days for HealthCo under the addendum.

3) Escalation and approval
- Anything that exceeds 90 minutes or touches additional regions will require DPO sign-off and a temporary exception ticket (Jira OPS-9123).

4) Deliverables we can provide for your review
- Signed audit bundle (sample) — attached in runbook appendix.
- DocuSign link for DPA addendum with the transient-hop clause pre-filled: https://app.docusign.com/documents/HC-DPA-Addendum-4872
- Internal ticket for the simulation and acceptance tests: https://redwood.internal/jira/OPS-9123

If this aligns with HealthCo's tolerance we can fold the clause into the addendum and sign. Please let us know if you want a stricter cap (e.g., 30 minutes) or additional telemetry fields in the audit events.

Next steps: Alex — confirmation on the 90-minute window and whether you'd like audit retention extended. Marissa / Karthik — stand by to produce the full signed bundle if Alex gives the go-ahead.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_residency_matrix_v1.xlsx, ops-transient-reprocessing-runbook.pdf
